schema_description: Resolved metadata sidecar for metrics_master.json (and metrics_master.csv, which is the CSV export). This is an aggregate file consolidated from per-condition CIs in results/paper-eval/**/consensus-analysis-report.json and results/paper-eval/pv/**/buffer_sensitivity.json. The underlying bootstrap spec is uniform across all rows.
registry_commit_note: Sidecar written at repository HEAD e038bfe8 on 2026-04-20 for archival completeness; the JSON was produced on 2026-03-27 and the CSV re-export on 2026-03-29. The consolidation is deterministic over its source files.

bootstrap.note: The aggregate inherits the bootstrap specification of its source files; each source file carries metadata_complete=YES in the CI registry.

source_file_sidecars: results/paper-eval/.metadata.json (directory-level sidecar covering all evaluate_detections.py outputs under paper-eval/)
Note: per-cell consensus-analysis-report.json and buffer_sensitivity.json files carry their own explicit metadata blocks (metadata_complete=YES in the registry).
ci_count: 100 rows x up to 3 metric CIs per row (F1, precision, recall) at up to 4 buffers each
notes: Main paper results table. Every row's bootstrap specification is (n=1000, seed=42, tile-level). Rows derive from source files that record full metadata; this sidecar exists so that the aggregate is self-describing and does not require the reader to chase the provenance chain when citing.
